cohort: Cytotrophoblasts (CTBs) from PAS cases and gestational age-matched control cells from preterm birth deliveries
finding: Cytotrophoblasts from PAS cases exhibit up-regulation of DOCK4, a gene promoting cell invasion and angiogenesis, suggesting a potential molecular mechanism for the increased invasion depth observed in PAS.
mod_finding: This study focuses on the role of cytotrophoblast invasion in placenta accreta spectrum (PAS), a condition linked to increased uterine surgeries like Cesarean sections, and doesn't directly compare modes of delivery.
